title: Fortnite Season 8 OG Pass: All Skins, Style Options, And Other Rewards
content: After four months of Season 7, we're finally moving on to Fortnite OG Season 8, and that means it's also time for a new OG pass to go with it. And we've got great news: Unlike the Season 7 pass, which time-gated half the rewards until a month into the season, the Season 8 OG pass is available in its entirety.
